programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Lissa Rankin, MD - Sacred Medicine
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Lissa Rankin, a physician and author who firmly believes Healthcare is a Human Right. Yet for so many in this country, exemplary care, and specifically alternative and complementary medicine may be prohibitive in cost except for the privileged few. She considers the wealth of knowledge gained through her experiences with indigenous cultures and being witness to their healing wisdom. Her latest book is Sacred Medicine: A Doctor's Quest to Unravel the Mysteries of Healing.
